extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy establishes Humana's expectations regarding cost-sharing for cost-share protected members.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.subsection: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: References > Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Some members are cost-share protected under federal law, meaning that providers must not collect from those members the calculated cost-sharing for covered services. Though the collection of cost-sharing from a member might be forbidden, if there is a payer subsequent to Humana, it might be possible to collect that cost-sharing from that subsequent payer. Humana uses remittance advice remark codes (RARCs) to indicate that members are cost-share protected. For example, a specific RARC's definition might be, "Alert: Patient is a Medicaid/Qualified Medicare Beneficiary. Review your records for any wrongfully collected deductible. This amount may be billed to a subsequent payer." A provider should note when a Humana electronic remittance advice (ERA) includes such a RARC and react to it appropriately.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Cost-share: Any portion of the amount allowed for a covered service that is attributed to deductible, copayment or coinsurance.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA): An explanation from a health plan, such as Humana, to a provider about a claim payment.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB): A low-income Medicare beneficiary who receives Medicare coverage of Part A and Part B premiums and cost- sharing.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARCs): Additional explanation for an adjustment already described by a Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) or to convey information about remittance processing.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content:
Cost-share: Any portion of the amount allowed for a covered service that is attributed to deductible, copayment or coinsurance.

Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA): An explanation from a health plan, such as Humana, to a provider about a claim payment.

Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB): A low-income Medicare beneficiary who receives Medicare coverage of Part A and Part B premiums and cost- sharing.

Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARCs): Additional explanation for an adjustment already described by a Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) or to convey information about remittance processing.
